jobs.description:
What if you could build the systems that allow industrial machines to understand where they are, decide where to go, and navigate safely through the real world?At M-ECS, you’ll help shape the next generation of autonomous off-highway vehicles and mobile robotic platforms. You'll work at the intersection of robotics, navigation and intelligent vehicle systems, developing the technology that enables machines to understand their position, plan their movements and navigate safely through complex environments. You’ll have the opportunity to help shape the autonomy stack from the ground up, from SLAM and localization to planning, decision-making and real-world deployment.You’ll see your work move from 
algorithm → machine → real-world impact.
 

 
 

YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT. As a Autonomous Navigation & SLAM Engineer, you’ll take ownership of the navigation and autonomy capabilities that enable mobile machines to operate safely and intelligently in complex, dynamic environments.
 

Key responsibilities: 
 
 

• Autonomy & Navigation: Developing navigation capabilities, including SLAM, localization, pose estimation and 2D/3D mapping. 

• Path Planning: Implementing global and local path planning, cost maps and collision-free trajectory generation for safe and efficient autonomous operation. 

• Behavioral Planning & Decision-Making: Developing intelligent real-time behaviors, including obstacle detection, prediction and avoidance, for actions such as driving, stopping, following and overtaking. 

• Sensor Fusion: Integrating data from cameras, LiDAR, radar, IMU and GNSS to improve localization, environmental awareness, and navigation. 

• Obstacle Detection & Avoidance: Developing capabilities to detect, predict and avoid obstacles in dynamic environments. 

• Real-Time Optimization: Improving navigation and planning algorithms for efficient real-time execution on embedded and GPU-based platforms. 

• System Integration & Validation: Integrating, testing, debugging and validating autonomous navigation systems together with other engineers, both in simulation and on real machines in the field. 

ARE YOU THE ONE?You're a 
hands-on engineer with a genuine 
passion for 
robotics, autonomous navigation and SLAM. You're fascinated by how machines understand their position, map their surroundings and navigate complex environments. You enjoy 
tackling technical challenges, developing algorithms and 
turning ideas into working solutions. You don't stop at simulation or the drawing board. You love programming, testing, debugging and seeing your work come to life on real machines. You're 
curious, 
analytical and 
eager to explore new technologies. You take 
initiative, think beyond the obvious and enjoy experimenting, solving problems and building intelligent systems alongside your team.
 
 

• A 
Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Automation, AI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

• A background/experience in (mobile) robotics, autonomous vehicles or industrial automation. 

• Experience with or 
technical knowledge of: 
 

• Autonomous navigation, 
SLAM, localization and state estimation, mapping, including LiDAR/visual SLAM, EKF or factor-graph approaches. 

• Path planning and trajectory optimization, e.g. A*, D* or RRT/RRT* 

• Programming in C++ and Python 

• Robotics frameworks such as ROS/ROS2 

• 3D Geometry, coordinate transformations, kinematics, sensor fusion, and real-time system constraints.   

• Experience with off-highway machinery, autonomous vehicles or AGVs, behavior trees, OMPL/MPC, GPU acceleration, simulation tools such as Gazebo, CARLA or Isaac Sim, NVIDIA Jetson or safety-critical systems is a plus. Experience testing or deploying robotic systems on real machines in the field is also a plus! 

• Strong communication skills in 
English and 
Dutch.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior .NET Developer / SQL Server & Manufacturing Applications
jobs.description:
Oliver James is looking for a Senior .NET Developer for an international manufacturer. You'll work on an in-house Manufacturing Execution System (MES) that has been in use for 15 years. Factory teams use the application across several sites to manage production recipes, manufacturing processes and quality checks.

SQL Server is the main technical requirement. The application handles millions of records. You'll need to investigate performance issues independently and decide when to change a query, an index or the way a table is partitioned. You'll also develop new features in ASP.NET and help migrate the application to a newer version of .NET.
What you'll do

You'll work alongside the person who built the application and gradually take ownership of changes from the first conversation with factory users through to delivery. For example, if a plant needs to change a quality check, you'll speak directly with the people who perform it, understand why the current process needs to change, discuss the technical impact, implement the change and validate it with the users.

You'll be expected to reach out to production, quality and IT stakeholders yourself. That includes visiting factories when it helps you understand how a process works on the floor. Several of your business contacts are based in Spain, and the client covers travel expenses.
What you'll bring

• Advanced SQL Server skills. You can write and optimise complex queries, read execution plans and make indexing and partitioning decisions on tables with millions of rows.

• Hands-on .NET and ASP.NET experience. You're comfortable finding your way around an established web application, extending it and contributing to its migration.

• Experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment. You've worked directly with people involved in industrial operations and understand how changes to software can affect their daily work.

• Experience with MES, production workflows or quality systems is particularly relevant.

• Functional analysis and ownership. You've taken a request from a business user, clarified the underlying need with business and technical stakeholders, and delivered the change yourself.

• Practical use of AI tools. You can use approved AI tools to help analyse requirements or develop a solution, check the output and work within the client's guidelines.

• Professional English. You can run discussions with factory users and technical colleagues in English. English is the only required language.

The selection process involves two to three interviews, including discussions with the technical lead and business stakeholders.

What if you could lead the development of the intelligence that makes industrial machines autonomous?
 

At M-ECS, you'll help shape the next generation of autonomous off-highway vehicles and mobile robotic platforms. You'll lead an ambitious autonomous driving project, developing the systems that allow machines to perceive and understand their surroundings, determine where they are, decide where to go and navigate safely through complex industrial environments. You'll bring together two key domains: Computer Vision & Perception and Autonomous Navigation & SLAM.
 

As Team Lead Autonomous Driving, you'll take ownership of the entire project, from defining the technical vision and architecture to managing development, setting priorities and leading a multidisciplinary engineering team. Combining strategic leadership with technical expertise and a hands-on mindset, you'll turn bold ideas into technology that works in the field.
 

This is a unique opportunity to lead a prestigious innovation project, partly supported by VLAIO (Flanders Innovation & Entrepreneurship), and make a lasting impact on the future of autonomous machines. You’ll see your work move from 
concept → 
algorithm → system → real-world impact.
 

 
 

YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT. 
 

As 
Team Lead Autonomous Driving, you'll take end-to-end ownership of M-ECS' autonomous driving capabilities. You'll connect the dots between perception, localization, mapping, planning and decision-making, ensuring all components work together as one intelligent system. You'll drive technical development and project execution, lead the team and stay closely involved in the engineering challenges, from code to real-world testing.
 

Key responsibilities: 
 
 

• Defining the vision and strategy: Translating business and project objectives into a clear technical vision, roadmap and development strategy for the full autonomy stack. 

• Driving technical architecture: Overseeing the architecture and integration of perception, sensor fusion, localization, SLAM, mapping, path planning, trajectory generation and behavioral decision-making. 

• Managing projects and priorities: Planning and coordinating development activities, setting priorities, managing resources, project budgets, and timelines, monitoring progress and ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and within budget. 

• Leading the team: Building, coaching and motivating a multidisciplinary team of engineers. 

• Hands-on development: Actively contributing to the development of the autonomy stack, getting involved in coding, prototyping and solving complex technical challenges. 

• Testing and validation: Ensuring algorithms and software are tested, optimized and validated on actual machines, under real operating conditions. 

• Ensuring technical excellence: Guiding key engineering decisions, establishing technical standards and overseeing system requirements, technical documentation, quality, performance and scalability of the solutions. 

• Ensuring system integration and alignment: Working closely with our engineers, management and customers to integrate the autonomy stack into real machines and align technical solutions with project goals, customer needs, and the broader M-ECS strategy. 

ARE YOU THE ONE? We're looking for a 
technical leader who combines a 
strong background in robotics and 
autonomous systems with the 
ability to lead people, projects and technology. You're comfortable switching between the bigger picture and the 
technical details. You can define a strategy, drive projects forward and make key decisions, but you're equally eager to get hands-on, explore different technologies and tackle complex engineering challenges alongside your team. You're 
proactive, 
pragmatic and 
results-driven. You enjoy bringing people and disciplines together, creating structure in complex projects and turning ambitious ideas into technology that works in the real world.
 
 

• A 
Master's or PhD degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Automation, AI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

• 5+ years of relevant experience in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or industrial automation. 

• Experience with or solid 
technical knowledge of: 
 

• Computer Vision & Perception, including deep learning and object detection. 

• Sensor fusion using cameras, LiDAR, radar, IMU and GNSS. 

• Autonomous Navigation & SLAM, including localization, 2D/3D mapping, path planning and behavioral decision-making. 

• C++ and Python programming, preferably ROS/ROS2. 

• 3D geometry, coordinate transformations, kinematics and real-time system constraints.   

• Experience with off-highway machinery, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), AGVs, embedded platforms, GPU acceleration or simulation environments is a plus. Experience taking autonomous systems from concept to real-world deployment is a strong advantage. 

• Experience leading or mentoring engineers and 
managing technical projects. 

• Fluency in 
English and 
Dutch.

jobs.occupation: IT Tribe Architect - DevEx & Cloud - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Architecture Department at BNP Paribas Fortis is the strategic backbone of our digital transformation.

We design the future of banking by shaping secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions that align business vision with cutting-edge IT. Our team of expert architects bridges the gap between security, agility, and customer-centric innovation, ensuring every system-from cloud to core banking-is built for performance, compliance, and seamless integration.

AND IN DETAIL

• You will design and validate solutions for development frameworks, platforms, and toolchains, enabling Dev Engineers to build and deploy scalable cloud-native applications.
• You will produce and maintain high-quality architecture documentation—including blueprints, solution architectures, and reference architectures—to ensure alignment with architectural standards, security policies, and business requirements.
• You will support other architects and development teams by providing expert guidance on scalable, resilient design patterns and cloud-native best practices.
• You will demystify complex technical concepts (e.g., service mesh, continuous delivery, infrastructure automation) to ensure solutions are secure, performant, and developer friendly.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Cloud-Native Development: Deep expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-native applications (microservices, containers) with a focus on scalability, resilience, and observability.
• Kubernetes & OpenShift: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift 
• IBM Cloud Platform: Proficiency in IBM Cloud services (e.g., Openshift and other native IBM Cloud services like EventStream, COS,…)
• Toolchain & Automation: Strong background in DevOps toolchains (CI/CD pipelines, GitOps) and infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible, scripting) to streamline development and deployment workflows.
• Java Frameworks: Experience with modern Java frameworks (Spring Boot) and their integration with cloud-native ecosystems.
• Developer Experience (DevEx): Ability to design and improve developer tools, platforms, and workflows to enhance productivity, reduce friction, and foster adoption of cloud-native practices.
• You are fluent in English (oral and written). Basic knowledge of Dutch or French is an asset.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for a CNC Operator to strengthen our teams.

As experienced CNC machine operator, you will oversee our computer numeric controlled (CNC) machines. You will be responsible for ensuring machining of subassembly, quality parts and tools specific to engineering drawings dimensions.

• Ensure CNC machines operate in compliance with company guidelines and safety standards.

• Inspect machinery daily to ensure proper functionality.
• Record all machine activities by completing production and quality logs.
• Provide accurate timelines and updates to clients.
• Communicate with the Methods Department regarding any issues encountered during machining.
• Ensure that machining results meet the defined work scope and quality expectations.
• Conduct regular assessments and maintenance of CNC machines.

Your Profile:

• High school diploma or equivalent qualification required.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a CNC machine operator.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and engineering drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude.
• Excellent attention to detail and a goal-oriented attitude.
• Strong comprehension and analytical skills.
• Knowledge of the latest equipment and techniques in the industry.
• Good computer skills.
• You have a very knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• Willingness to work in a 3-shift system
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Pattyn Group (€158 million turnover), headquartered in Bruges, is a pioneer in automated packaging solutions. We specialize in bulk packaging for a wide range of industries, including food, pharmaceuticals, and industrial goods. We design and build innovative, high-quality packaging machinery that seamlessly integrates into production lines, helping customers improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance product safety throughout the packaging process.
 

We operate in five countries, with production sites in Bruges (Pattyn Belgium & Pattyn Metal Construction), Deerlijk (Pattyn Bulk Packaging), France (Pattyn France) and Spain (GMP) as well as sales and service centers in Kuala Lumpur (Pattyn Asia) and North America (Pattyn North America). With over 250 employees in Belgium and more than 600 colleagues worldwide, we continue to grow and strengthen our position as a global partner in packaging technology.
 

As a proud member of the 
Duravant family, a global leader in engineered equipment and automation solutions, Pattyn benefits from an extensive international network, strategic investments, and access to cutting-edge technologies. This partnership enables us to further expand our expertise, accelerate innovation, and deliver groundbreaking packaging solutions to customers around the world. Driven by a passionate team of professionals, we continuously push the boundaries of packaging automation while fostering an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and rewarding environment where talented people can grow and make an impact.
 

Your challenge
 

The Group Accounting & Internal Controls Manager is responsible for ensuring consistent, accurate and compliant accounting practices across all Pattyn Group entities. 
 

The role drives the standardization of accounting policies, safeguards the integrity of financial reporting and internal controls, and acts as the primary point of contact for external auditors across the Group. 
 

In addition, the position plays a key role in improving the efficiency and reliability of financial closing processes, strengthening financial governance and supporting local finance teams in applying Group standards and best practices.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Group Accounting Governance & Compliance 

• External Audit Management 

• Internal Controls & SOX Compliance 

• Balance Sheet Integrity & Reconciliations 

• Financial Closing & Process Improvement 

• Stakeholder Management & Capability Building  

 

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field; professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA or equivalent) preferred. 

• Minimum 7 years of relevant experience, preferably including Big 4 audit and/or Group Accounting in a multinational environment. 

• Strong knowledge of IFRS and/or US GAAP, consolidation, SOX compliance and internal control frameworks. 

• Proven experience in external audit management and international accounting practices. 

• Strong analytical skills, technical rigor and attention to detail, with a high standard for accuracy and compliance. 

• Process-driven and improvement-oriented, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and implement practical solutions. 

• Strong ownership, organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority and coach local finance teams. 

• Strong ERP knowledge, advanced Excel skills and affinity with digitalization and automation. 

• Fluent English; French is a strong asset.

For a leading utilities client in Brussels, we are looking for an experienced Endpoint Engineer to strengthen the Endpoint Management team. This position offers the opportunity to work in a complex enterprise environment while contributing to the ongoing modernization of the workplace ecosystem.

You will be involved in both operational and project-based activities, supporting a fleet of approximately 2,500 endpoints serving 1,500 users.
